svg.title: Security follows permissions
svg.desc: A four-step chain tracing one reported incident: Context.ai, a third-party AI tool, is compromised; the employee's Google Workspace account is taken over; the employee's Vercel account and environment are reached; customer environment variables not marked sensitive are accessed. A note marks this as a useful example of how access travels through an AI service and its integrations, not evidence the model failed and not part of IBM's statistic.

text.tspan: One incident, traced step by step — Vercel's own account, not a general architecture.
VERCEL'S ACCOUNT OF THE INCIDENT — OCTOBER UPDATE
WHAT IT IS — AND IS NOT
A useful example of how access travels through an AI
service and its integrations — Vercel's own account.
Not evidence the model failed, and not part of IBM's
The important security boundary is the one that governs the entire path
from the model to the data and actions it can touch.
